ja547:159.1: Āmantayittha rājānaṃ Sañjayaṃ dhamminaṃ varaṃ: avaruddhasi maṃ deva, Vaṃkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ.
ja547:160.1: Ye hi keci mahārāja bhūtā ye ca bhavissare atittā yeva kāmehi gacchanti Yamasādanaṃ.
ja547:161.1: So 'haṃ sake abhisasiṃ yajamāno sake pure, Sivīnaṃ vacanatthena samhā raṭṭhā nirajj' ahaṃ.
ja547:162.1: Aghaṃ taṃ patisevissaṃ vane [vālamigākiṇṇe khagga] dīpinisevite ahaṃ puññāni karomi, tumhe paṃkamhi sīdathā 'ti.
ja547:163.1: Anujānāhi maṃ amma, pabbajjā mama ruccati, so 'haṃ sake abhisasiṃ yajamāno sake pure, Sivīnaṃ vacanatthena samhā raṭṭhā nirajj' ahaṃ.
ja547:164.1: Aghaṃ taṃ patisevissaṃ vane [valamigākiṇṇe khagga] dīpinisevite, ahaṃ puññāni karomi, tumhe paṃkamhi sīdathā 'ti.
ja547:165.1: Anujānāmi taṃ putta, pabbajjā te samijjhatu, ayañ ca Maddī kalyāṇī susaññā tanumajjhimā acchataṃ saha puttehi, kiṃ araññe karissatīti.
ja547:166.1: Nāhaṃ akāmā dāsim pi araññaṃ netum ussahe, sace icchati anvetu, sace n' icchati acchatū
ja547:167.1: 'ti. Tato suṇhaṃ mahārājā yācituṃ paṭipajjatha: mā candanasamācāre rajojallaṃ adhārayi,
ja547:168.1: Mā kāsiyāni dhāretvā kusacīram adhārayi, dukkho vāso araññasmiṃ, mā hi tvaṃ lakkhaṇe gamīti.
ja547:169.1: Tam abravī rājaputtī Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā: nāhaṃ taṃ sukham iccheyyaṃ yaṃ me Vessantaraṃ vinā
ja547:170.1: ti. Tam abravī mahārājā Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano: iṃgha Maddi nisāmehi vane ye honti dussahā
ja547:171.1: Bahū kīṭā paṭaṃgā ca makasā madhumakkhikā te pi taṃ tattha hiṃseyyuṃ, tan te dukkhataraṃ siyā.
ja547:172.1: Apare passa santāpe nadīn' ūpa nisevite: sappā ajagarā nāma avisā te mahabbalā
ja547:173.1: Te manussaṃ migaṃ vāpi api-m-āsannam āgataṃ parikkhipitvā bhogehi vasam ānenti attano.
ja547:174.1: Aññe pi kaṇhajaṭino acchā nāma aghammigā na tehi puriso diṭṭho rukkham āruyha muccati.
ja547:175.1: Saṃghaṭṭayantā siṃgāni tikkhaggā tippahārino mahisā vicarant' ettha nadiṃ Sotumbaraṃ pati.
ja547:176.1: Disvā migānaṃ yūthāni gavaṃ sañcarataṃ vane dhenu va vacchagiddhā va kathaṃ Maddi karissasi.
ja547:177.1: Disvā sampatite ghore dumagge suplavaṃgame akhettaññāya te Maddi bhavitan te mahabbhayaṃ.
ja547:178.1: Yā tvaṃ sivāya sutvāna muhuṃ uttasayī pure sā tvaṃ Vaṃkaṃ anuppattā kathaṃ Maddi karissasi.
ja547:179.1: Thite majjhantike kāle sannisinnesu pakkhisu sanate va brahāraññaṃ, tattha kiṃ gantuṃ icchasīti.
ja547:180.1: Tam abravī rājaputtī Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā: yāni etāni akkhāsi vane paṭibhayāni me sabbāni abhisambhossaṃ, gacchaṃ ñeva rathesabha.
ja547:181.1: Kāsaṃ kusaṃ poṭakilaṃ usīraṃ muñjapabbajaṃ urasā padahessāmi, nāssa hessāmi dunnayā.
ja547:182.1: Bahūhi vata cariyāhi kumārī vindate patiṃ udarass' uparodhena gohanubbeṭhanena ca.
ja547:183.1: Aggissa paricariyāya udakummajjanena ca vedhabbaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke gacchañ ñeva rathesabha.
ja547:184.1: Api 'ssā hoti appatto ucchiṭṭham api bhuñjituṃ yo naṃ hatthe gahetvāna akāmaṃ parikaḍḍhati, vedhabbaṃ kaṭukaṃ loke gacchaṃ ñeva rathesabha.
ja547:185.1: Kesaggahaṇamukkhepā bhumyā ca parisumbhanā datvā ca nopakkamati bahuṃ dukkhaṃ anappakaṃ, vedhabbaṃ etc. Sukkacchavivedhaverā
ja547:186.1: datvā subhagamānino akāmaṃ parikaḍḍhanti ulūkaṃ ñeva vāyasā, ve- etc. Api ñātikule phīte
ja547:187.1: kaṃsapajjotane vasaṃ n' evātivākyaṃ na labhe bhātūhi sakhikāhi ca, ve- etc. Naggā nadī anodakā naggaṃ
ja547:188.1: raṭṭhaṃ arājikaṃ itthī pi vidhavā naggā yassāpi dasa bhātaro, ve- etc. Dhajo rathassa paññāṇaṃ,
ja547:189.1: dhūmo paññāṇam aggino, rājā raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, bhattā paññāṇam itthiyā ve- etc. Yā daliddī daliddassa
ja547:190.1: aḍḍhā aḍḍhassa kittimā taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti dukkaraṃ hi karoti sā.
ja547:191.1: Sāmikaṃ anubandhissaṃ sadā kāsāyavāsinī, pathavyāpi abhejjantyā n' icche Vessantaraṃ vinā, ve- etc.
ja547:192.1: Api sāgarapariyantaṃ bahuṃ vittadharaṃ mahiṃ nānāratanaparipūraṃ n' icche Vessantaraṃ vinā.
ja547:193.1: Kathan nu tāsaṃ hadayaṃ, sukharā vata itthiyo yā sāmike dukkhitamhi sukhaṃ icchanti attano.
ja547:194.1: Nikkhamante mahārāje Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhane tam ahaṃ anubandhissaṃ, sabbakāmadado hi me
ja547:195.1: 'ti. Tam abravī mahārājā Maddiṃ sabbaṅgasobhanaṃ: ime te daharā puttā Jāli Kaṇhājinā vubho nikkhippa lakkhaṇe gaccha, mayan te posiyāmase
ja547:196.1: ti. Tam abravī rājaputtī Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā: piyā me puttakā deva Jāli Kaṇhājinā vubho, ty-amhaṃ tattha ramessanti araññe jīvasokinan ti.
ja547:197.1: Tam abravi mahārājā Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano: sālinam odanaṃ bhutvā suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ rukkhaphalāni bhuñjantā kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:198.1: Bhutvā sataphale kaṃse sovaṇṇe satarājike rukkhapattesu bhuñjantā kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:199.1: Kāsiyāni ca dhāretvā khomakodumbarāni ca kusacīrāni dhārentā kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:200.1: Vayhāhi pariyāyitvā sivikāya rathena ca pattikā paridhāvantā kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:201.1: Kūṭāgāre sayitvāna nivāse phussitaggaḷe sayantā rukkhamūlasmiṃ kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:202.1: Pallaṃkesu sayitvāna gonake cittasanthate sayantā tiṇasanthāre kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:203.1: Gandhikena vilimpitvā agarucandanena ca rajojallāni dhārentā kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā.
ja547:204.1: Cāmaramorahatthehi vijitaṅgā sukhe ṭhitā daṭṭhā ḍaṃsehi makasehi kathaṃ kāhanti dārakā
ja547:205.1: ti. Tam abravī rājaputtī Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā: mā deva paridevesi mā ca tvaṃ vimano ahu, yathā mayaṃ bhavissāma tathā hessanti dārakā.
ja547:206.1: Idaṃ vatvāna pakkāmi Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā, Sivimaggena anvesi putte ādāya lakkhaṇā
ja547:207.1: ti. Tato Vessantaro rājā dānaṃ datvāna khattiyo pitu mātuc ca vanditvā katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ
ja547:208.1: Catuvāhiṃ rathaṃ yuttaṃ sīgham āruyha sandanaṃ ādāya puttadārañ ca Vaṃkaṃ pāyāsi pabbatan
ja547:209.1: ti. Tato Vessantaro rājā yenāsi bahuko jano āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma ārogā hontu ñātayo
ja547:211.1: ti. Taṃ brāhmaṇā anvagamuṃ, te taṃ asse ayācisuṃ, yācito paṭipādesi catunnaṃ caturo haye
ja547:212.1: ti. Iṃgha Maddi nisāmehi: cittarūpaṃ va dissati, migarohiccavaṇṇena dakkhiṇassā vahanti man ti,
ja547:213.1: Ath' ettha pañcamo āgā, so taṃ ratham ayācatha, tassa taṃ yācito dāsi, na c' assu pahato mano.
ja547:214.1: Tato Vessantaro rājā oropetvā sakaṃ janaṃ assāsayi assa ratham brāhmaṇassa dhanesino
ja547:215.1: ti. Tvaṃ Maddi Kaṇhājinaṃ gaṇha, lahukā esā kaniṭṭhikā, ahaṃ Jāliṃ gaṇhissāmi, garuko bhātiko hi so ti.
ja547:216.1: Rājā kumāram ādāya rājaputtī ca dārikaṃ sammodamānā pakkāmuṃ aññamaññaṃ piyaṃvadā
ja547:218.0: ti. Yadi keci manujā enti anumagge paṭīpathe maggan te paṭipucchāma: kuhiṃ Vaṃkatapabbato.
ja547:219.1: Te tattha amhe passitvā karuṇaṃ paridevayuṃ, dukkhan te paṭivedenti: dūre Vaṃkatapabbato ti.
ja547:220.1: Yadi passanti pavane dārakā phalite dume tesaṃ phalānaṃ hetūhi uparodanti dārakā.
ja547:221.1: Rodante dārake disvā ubbiggā vipulā dumā sayam ev' onamitvāna upagacchanti dārake.
ja547:222.1: Idaṃ accherakaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ sādhukāraṃ pavattesi Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā:
ja547:223.1: Accheraṃ vata lokasmiṃ abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ Vessantarassa tejena sayam ev' onatā dumā ti.
ja547:224.1: Saṃkhipiṃsu pathaṃ yakkhā anukampāya dārake, nikkhantadivasen' eva Cetaraṭṭham upāgamun
ja547:225.1: ti. Te gantvā dīgham addhānaṃ Cetaraṭṭham upāgamuṃ, iddhaṃ phītaṃ janapadaṃ bahumaṃsasurodananti.
ja547:226.1: Cetiyo parikiriṃsu disvā lakkhaṇam āgatam: sukhumālī vata ayyā{} pattikā paridhāvati.
ja547:227.1: Vayhāhi pariyāyitvā sivikāya ca khattiyā sājja Maddī araññasmiṃ pattikā paridhāvatīti.
ja547:228.1: Taṃ disvā Cetapāmokkhā rodamānā upāgamuṃ: kaccin nu deva kusalaṃ, kacci deva anāmayaṃ, kacci pitā ārogo te Sivīnañ ca anāmayaṃ.
ja547:229.1: Ko te balaṃ mahārāja, ko nu te rathamaṇḍalaṃ, anassako arathako dīgham addhānam āgato, kacc' āmittehi pakato anuppatto s' imaṃ disan ti.
ja547:230.1: Kusalañ c' eva me samma, atho samma anāmayaṃ, atho pitā arogo me Sivīnañ ca anāmayaṃ.
ja547:231.1: Ahaṃ hi kuñjaraṃ dajjaṃ īsādantaṃ urūḷhavaṃ (Cfr. supra V. khettaññuṃ sabbayuddhānaṃ sabbasetaṃ gajuttamaṃ
ja547:232.1: Paṇḍukambalasañchannaṃ pabhinnaṃ sattumaddanaṃ dantiṃ savālavījaniṃ setaṃ Kelāsa-sādisaṃ
ja547:233.1: Sasetacchattaṃ saupatheyyaṃ sāthabbanaṃ sahatthipaṃ aggayānaṃ rājavāhiṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ adās' ahaṃ.
ja547:234.1: Tasmiṃ me Sivayo kuddhā, pitā c' upahato mano, avaruddhati maṃ rājā, Vaṃkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ, okāsaṃ sammā jānātha vane yattha vasāmase ti.
ja547:235.1: Svāgatan te mahārāja atho te adurāgataṃ, issaro si anuppatto yaṃ idh' atthi pavedaya.
ja547:236.1: Sākaṃ bhisaṃ madhuṃ maṃsaṃ suddhaṃ sālinam odanaṃ paribhuñja mahārāja, pāhuno no si āgato ti.
ja547:237.1: Paṭiggahītaṃ yaṃ dinnaṃ sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ, avaruddhati maṃ rājā, Vaṃkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ, okāsaṃ samma jānātha vane yattha vasāmase
ja547:238.1: ti, Idh' eva tāva acchassu Cetaraṭṭhe rathesabha yāva Cetā gamissanti rañño santikaṃ yācituṃ
ja547:239.1: nijjhāpetuṃ mahārājaṃ Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhanam. Taṃ taṃ Cetā purakkhatvā patītā laddhapaccayā parivāretvāna gacchanti, evaṃ jānāhi khattiyā 'ti.
ja547:240.1: Mā vo ruccittha gamanaṃ rañño santika yācitum nijjhāpetuṃ mahārājaṃ, rājā tattha na issaro.
ja547:241.1: Accuggatā hi Sivayo balatthā negamā ca ye te padhaṃsetum icchanti rājānaṃ mama kāraṇā ti.
ja547:242.1: Sace esā pavatt' ettha raṭṭhasmiṃ raṭṭhavaddhana idh' eva rajjaṃ kārehi Cetehi parivārito.
ja547:243.1: Iddham phītañ c' idaṃ raṭṭhaṃ iddho janapado mahā, matiṃ karohi tvaṃ deva rajjassa-m-anusāsitun ti.
ja547:244.1: Na me chando mati atthi rajjassa-m-anusāsituṃ pabbājitassa raṭṭhasmā, Cetaputtā sunātha me.
ja547:245.1: Atuṭṭhā Sivayo assu balatthā negamā ca ye pabbājitassa raṭṭhasmā, Cetā rajje hi secayuṃ.
ja547:246.1: Asammodiyam pi vo assa accantaṃ mama kāraṇā Sivīnaṃ bhaṇḍanañ cāpi, viggaho me na ruccati.
ja547:247.1: Ath' assa bhaṇḍanaṃ ghoraṃ sampahāro anappako, ekassa kāraṇā mayhaṃ hiṃseyyuṃ bahuke jane.
ja547:248.1: Paṭiggahītaṃ yaṃ dinnaṃ sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ, avaruddhati maṃ rājā, Vaṃkaṃ gacchāmi pabbataṃ, okāsaṃ sammā jānātha vane yattha vasāmase
ja547:249.1: ti. Taggha te mayam akkhāma yathāpi kusalā tathā rājisī yattha sammanti āhutaggī samāhitā.
ja547:250.1: Esa selo mahārāja pabbato Gandhamādano yattha tvaṃ saha puttehi saha bhariyāya c' acchasi.
ja547:251.1: Taṃ Cetā anusāsiṃsu assunettā rudammukhā, ito gaccha mahārāja ujju yen' uttarāmukho.
ja547:252.1: Atha dakkhasi bhaddan te Vipulaṃ nāma pabbataṃ nānādumagaṇākiṇṇaṃ sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ.
ja547:253.1: Tam atikkamma bhaddan te atha dakkhasi āpakaṃ nadiṃ Ketumatiṃ nāma gambhīraṃ girigabbharaṃ
ja547:254.1: Puthulomamacchākiṇṇaṃ supatitthaṃ mahodakaṃ, tattha nahātvā pivitvā ca assāsetvā saputtake
ja547:255.1: Atha dakkhasi bhaddan te nigrodhaṃ maddhuvipphalaṃ rammake sikhare jātaṃ sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ.
ja547:256.1: Atha dakkhasi bhaddan te Nālikaṃ nāma pabbataṃ nānādijagaṇākiṇṇaṃ selaṃ kimpurisāyutaṃ.
ja547:257.1: Tassa uttarapubbena Mucalindo nāmaso saro puṇḍarikehi sañchanno setasogandhiyehi ca.
ja547:258.1: So vanaṃ meghasaṃkāsaṃ dhuvaṃ haritasaddalaṃ sīho vāmisapekkhīva vanasaṇḍaṃ vigāhiya puppharukkhehi sañchannaṃ phalarukkhehi c' ūbhayaṃ.
ja547:259.1: Tattha bindussarā vaggū nānāvaṇṇā bahū dijā kujjantam upakujjanti utusampupphite dume.
ja547:260.1: Gantvā girividuggānaṃ nadīnaṃ pabhavāni ca so dakkhasi pokkharaṇiṃ karañjakakudhāyutaṃ
ja547:261.1: Puthulomamacchākiṇṇaṃ supatitthaṃ mahodakaṃ samañ ca caturassañ ca sāduṃ appaṭigandhiyaṃ.
ja547:262.1: Tassā uttarapubbena paṇṇasālaṃ amāpaya paṇṇasālaṃ amāpetvā uñchacariyāya īhathā
ja547:264.0: 'ti. Ahu vāsī Kaliṅgesu Jūjako nāma brāhmaṇo tassāpi daharā bhariyā nāmen-Āmittatāpanā.
ja547:265.1: Tā taṃ tattha gatā vocuṃ nadīudakahārikā thiyo taṃ paribhāsiṃsu samāgantvā kutūhalā:
ja547:266.1: Amittā nūna te mātā Amittā nūna te pitā ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu evaṃ dahariyaṃ sati. Ahitaṃ
ja547:267.1: vata te ñātī mantayiṃsu rahogatā ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu evaṃ dahariyaṃ sati. Dukkaraṃ
ja547:269.1: vata te ñātī mantayiṃsu rahogatā ye etc. Pāpakaṃ
ja547:270.1: vata te ñātī mantayiṃsu rahogatā ye etc. Amanāpaṃ
ja547:271.1: vata te ñātī mantayiṃsu rahogatā ye etc. Amanāpavāsaṃ vasasi evaṃ dahariyaṃ sati yā
ja547:272.1: tvaṃ vasasi jiṇṇassa, mataṃ te jīvitā varaṃ.
ja547:273.1: Na hi nūna tuyhaṃ kalyāṇi pitā mātā ca sobhane aññaṃ bhattāraṃ vindiṃsu [ye taṃ jiṇṇa pādaṃsu] evaṃ dahariyaṃ sati. Duyyiṭṭhaṃ
ja547:274.1: te navamiyaṃ akataṃ aggihuttakaṃ ye etc. Samaṇe
ja547:275.1: brāhmaṇe nūna brahmacariyaparāyane sā tvaṃ loke abhisasi sīlavante bahussute yā tvaṃ vasasi jiṇṇassa evaṃ dahariyaṃ sati.
ja547:276.1: Na dukkhaṃ ahinā daḍḍhaṃ na dukkhaṃ sattiyā hataṃ tañ ca dukkhañ ca tippañ ca yaṃ passe jiṇṇakaṃ patiṃ.
ja547:277.1: N' atthi khiḍḍā n' atthi rati jiṇṇena patinā saha, n' atthi allāpasallāpo, jagghitam pi na sobhati.
ja547:278.1: Yadā daharo daharā ca mantayanti rahogatā sabbāsaṃ sokā nassanti ye keci hadayanissitā.
ja547:279.1: Daharā tvaṃ rūpavatī purisānaṃ abhipatthitā, gaccha ñātikule accha, kiṃ jiṇṇo ramayissatīti.
ja547:280.1: Na te brāhmaṇa gacchāma nadiṃ udakabāriyā, thiyo maṃ paribhāsanti tayā jiṇṇena brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja547:281.1: Mā me tvaṃ akarā kammaṃ, mā me udakam āhari, ahaṃ udakaṃ āhissaṃ, mā bhoti kupitā ahū 'ti.
ja547:282.1: Nāhaṃ tamhi kule jātā yaṃ tvaṃ udakam āhare, evaṃ brāhmaṇa jānāhi na te vacchām' ahaṃ ghare.
ja547:283.1: Sace me dāsaṃ dāsiṃ vā nānayissasi brāhmaṇa evaṃ brāhmaṇa jānāhi na te vacchāmi santike ti.
ja547:284.1: N' atthi me sippaṭṭhānaṃ vā dhanadhaññaṃ vā brāhmaṇi kuto 'haṃ dāsaṃ dāsiṃ vā ānayissāmi bhotiyā, ahaṃ bhotiṃ upaṭṭhissaṃ, mā bhoti kupitā ahū 'ti.
